output.content: I was digging through the deployment logs for the last few releases and noticed the canary test results sit there unreviewed. No human looks at the output before the deployment proceeds. There is no sign off, no formal gate, and no partial review step in the current workflow. The system just moves forward based on the automated pass or fail status. The infrastructure handles the execution, but the governance layer for that specific check is effectively empty.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current state of the deployment workflow and the absence of human review steps without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
